name: silvann agentic skills repository
description: tools for SiLVANN's REPL, a package a folder, each tool one Python file its (add_tool …) installs

data.description: Tables and records: CSV and JSON files read.
data.about:
Tools that read a CSV or JSON file in the working folder: a table's columns, a record's value. They read; they never
write.

csv_columns.doc: A CSV file's columns: their names, or one column's values.

verbs.name: csv-names
verbs.about: The names of the CSV file's columns, in order.

verbs.name: csv-column
verbs.about: The values of one column of the CSV file, top to bottom.

json_value.doc: A value in a JSON file, at a path of keys and indexes.

verbs.name: json-value
verbs.about: The value in the JSON file at path found by keys, dot-joined ("" the whole file).

text.description: Text in files: words counted, lines found.
text.about:
Tools that read a text file in the working folder and answer what is in it, for the REPL's model to use on documents,
notes and logs. They read; they never write.

count_words.doc: Words, lines and characters counted in a text file.

verbs.name: count-words
verbs.about: The words, lines and characters of the text file at path.

find_lines.doc: The lines of a text file that hold a word, with their numbers.

verbs.name: find-lines
verbs.about: The lines of the file at path that hold word, case ignored, each as "number: line".

units.description: Quantities converted between units: length, mass, temperature, time.
units.about:
A number and its unit's name in, the number in another unit out — metric and imperial lengths and masses, Celsius,
Fahrenheit and Kelvin, seconds to days.

convert.doc: Quantities converted between units: length, mass, temperature and time.

verbs.name: convert-units
verbs.about: value in from_unit, as to_unit: 12 "ft" "m" is 3.6576.
